_about: Everything the habitat and Mission Control say. tools/generate_voice.py speaks each variant to assets/audio/voice/<id>_<n>.wav (Mission Control as mc_<id>_<n>.wav); the game plays a random variant and shows its text as a caption. The habitat speaks in the first person, warm and a little dry, and says what to do, not just what's wrong. Keep lines short: the numbers are on screen.

life_support_power_critical: Life support has no power. I can't keep the air clean without it.
I've lost power to life support. Get me power, any way you can.
Life support is dark. This one's serious. Power, please.
power_warning: I'm using more power than I'm making. I've switched off the extras.
Power's short. I've turned off what we can live without.
We're over budget on power. Some systems are off until we catch up.
battery_sunset_advisory: Heads up. The batteries are low, and the sun's going down.
Sunset's coming and the batteries aren't full. Worth a look.
Night's on its way. I'd like more charge in the batteries.
o2_warning: I'm losing oxygen faster than I can make it.
Oxygen's dropping. Check the oxygen generator.
The air's getting thin in here. Oxygen is falling.
o2_critical: Oxygen is low. Everyone's breathing harder. Please hurry.
Oxygen is critical. Fix the generator, or open the reserve tank.
We're running out of oxygen. This is the big one.
co2_warning: Carbon dioxide is building up. The air needs scrubbing.
The air's getting stale. Carbon dioxide is rising.
I can't clear the carbon dioxide fast enough.
co2_critical: Carbon dioxide is at a dangerous level. Headaches are next.
The carbon dioxide is too high. Get the air recycler running.
Carbon dioxide is critical. The crew can't stay in this air.
cold_warning: It's getting cold in here. Check the heaters.
Cabin temperature's dropping. Mars is winning.
I'm losing heat. Somebody turn the heating up.
cold_critical: It's dangerously cold. The crew need heat now.
The cabin is freezing. Heaters, please. Quickly.
Temperature is critical. Nobody can work in this cold.
water_warning: Water's getting low. The reclaimer or the ice extractor might help.
The water tanks are low. Time to find more.
water_critical: We're out of water. This is urgent.
The water's gone. The crew can't last long without it.
No water left. Please make this the first thing you fix.
food_warning: Food's running low. The grow trays could use some help.
We're getting through the food faster than we grow it.
food_critical: We're out of food. The crew are hungry.
No food left. Grow more, or wait for a supply drop.
The food has run out. This one can't wait.
health_warning: The crew aren't doing well. Their health is slipping.
Crew health is dropping. Something here is hurting them.
I'm worried about the crew. Check the systems panel.
health_critical: The crew are in danger. Please fix this now.
Crew health is critical. Whatever's wrong, it's urgent.
The crew can't take much more of this.
resolved_life_support_power: Power to life support restored. Breathing easy again.
Life support is running. That was close.
resolved_power: Power's balanced again. Switching things back on.
resolved_o2: Oxygen's back to normal. Breathe easy.
resolved_co2: Carbon dioxide is back to normal.
Fresh air. Well, fresh for Mars.
resolved_health: The crew are on the mend.
storm_forecast: There's a dust storm coming. Charge the batteries while the sun's out.
Storm on the way. Fill the batteries now. The panels won't get much soon.
I can see a dust storm on the horizon. Let's get ready.
storm_arrived: The storm's here. The panels are barely getting any sun.
We're in the dust storm now. Go easy on the power.
Dust storm overhead. Solar power is down to a trickle.
storm_cleared: The storm's passed. The sun's coming back.
Dust storm's over. The panels are waking up.
We made it through the storm. Nice.
welcome_aboard: Welcome aboard. All systems online. I'm glad you're here.
cold_spot_warning: One of the rooms has a cold spot.
There's a cold spot. A room isn't getting enough heat.
Somewhere in here is colder than it should be.
radiation_critical: Solar particle event. Everyone to the storm shelter, now.
The Sun's thrown a radiation storm at us. Get to the shelter.
Radiation alert. Storm shelter, everyone. Don't wait.
radiation_warning: The radiation storm's still going. Stay in the shelter.
Not yet. It's still not safe outside the shelter.
Radiation's still high. Hang in there.
resolved_radiation: Radiation's back to normal. You can come out.
All clear. The radiation storm has passed.
Safe to leave the shelter now.
breach_critical: Hull breach. I'm sealing the hatches.
We've got a hole in the hull. Sealing the doors.
Breach. Air is leaking. Closing the hatches.
breakdown_warning: Something's broken. It needs a repair.
A machine has failed. Spare parts would help.
breakdown_critical: A life support machine has failed. It needs fixing right away.
Life support's broken. Spare parts, please.
Critical breakdown. Life support is down.
blackout_advisory: We've lost contact with Earth. The Sun's in the way.
The Sun's between us and Earth. No messages for a while.
Blackout. Earth can't hear us. We're on our own for now.
resolved_blackout: We're back in touch with Earth.
Contact with Earth restored. Messages are getting through again.
Earth's back. Mission Control will be glad to hear from us.
injury_warning: Someone's been hurt. They need the medical bay.
We've got an injury. Medical bay, please.
injury_advisory: Someone's been hurt. Nothing serious, but they need looking after.
Minor injury. The medical bay can help.
fitness_warning: The crew aren't getting enough exercise. Their muscles are weakening.
Low gravity's getting to the crew. They need exercise.
fitness_critical: The crew are getting weak. They need exercise stations.
Crew fitness is low. Bones and muscles are suffering.
The crew are losing strength. Get them exercising.
wellbeing_warning: Morale's dipping. Check what they're missing.
The crew could use a bit of cheering up.
wellbeing_critical: The crew are really struggling. They need more than air and food.
Morale is very low. The crew page shows what's missing.
The crew are unhappy. Let's look after them.
resolved_injury: The injured crew member is better now.
resolved_fitness: The crew are getting strong again.
seismic_activity: I felt that. A marsquake. Nothing to worry about.
Marsquake. Just a small one. Everything's holding.
Did you feel that? Seismic activity. We're fine.
remark_dawn: Sunrise. The panels are waking up.
The sun's up. Blue light to start, then butterscotch.
remark_dusk: Sunset. Look out a window. The sky goes blue around the sun.
Getting dark. I'll keep the lights on.
Evening. The batteries take over from here.
remark_night: It's minus seventy outside. Glad we're in here.
If you look up tonight, the bright dot is Earth.
remark_calm: Everything's running nicely. Just thought you'd like to know.
Air's fresh, the heaters are on, nothing's on fire. A good day.
All systems normal. I like it when it's boring.
I've checked everything twice. We're fine.
Did you know a sol is thirty-nine minutes longer than a day on Earth?

hello: Mission Control here. We've got your landing signal. Welcome to Mars. Everyone here is cheering.
This is Mission Control. Landing confirmed. Welcome to Mars.
first_room: Mission Control. We see your first sealed room. That's a real home on another planet.
Mission Control. Pressure readings from your first room look great. Nice building.
storm_after: Mission Control. We saw the dust storm on our satellites. Glad you came through it.
Mission Control. Our weather team tracked that storm. It looks like you handled it well.
critical_after: Mission Control. We just saw your critical alert. By the time this reaches you, we hope it's already fixed.
Mission Control. We got your alert. We know you're on your own for this one. We trust you.
blackout_after: Mission Control. The Sun's out of the way. It's good to hear from you again.
Mission Control. Contact restored. We missed you.
sol_10: Mission Control. Ten sols on Mars. Keep it up.
sol_30: Mission Control. Thirty sols. That's longer than anyone has ever stayed on Mars before.
sol_100: Mission Control. One hundred sols. The whole team signed a card for you.
sol_669: Mission Control. A full Martian year. Happy anniversary, colony.
tip: Mission Control. Reminder: water is heavy to ship from Earth. Every litre you recycle is a win.
Mission Control. Our engineers say batteries are your best friend at night. And during storms.
Mission Control. The crew's families say hello.
Mission Control. Take a moment to look outside. Not many people have seen that view.
Mission Control. Students on Earth are following your mission. No pressure.
